'''Vindoo Barvel''', also known by the moniker "'''The Shooter'''," was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who met the standards for [[Ace/Legends|ace]] status multiple [[Time/Legends|times]] and was one of the most decorated [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. Barvel, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Following the [[Declaration of a New Order]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Barvel became a recruiter for the Imperial Navy, where he played on his reputation as one of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] best pilots to attract recruits. Barvel, who was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] by then, also served as the head of the pilot school at [[Imperial City Naval Base]]. Eventually becoming a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]], Barvel at one point after attaining the latter [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] flew against [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in a training exercise with powered-down [[Laser/Legends|lasers]]. Though he was considered one of the galaxy's best pilots, Barvel proved no match for Vader, who shot him down.

==Biography==
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="SWG" /> Vindoo Barvel fought in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on the side of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Flying with the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], he was known as one of the best [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] on the Republic's side. Barvel, nicknamed "The Shooter," had over thirty confirmed kills, twice that many probables, and it was unknown how many kills he did not report.<ref name="ds" /> Following the end of the war and [[Declaration of a New Order|creation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Barvel continued to serve in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]], now under the Empire. However, he was pulled out of active duty and became a recruiter for the Empire. Barvel, with his reputation as one of the best pilots in the Imperial Navy, was considered a hero by many. Having the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Captain/Legends|captain]] by that point, Barvel was also placed in charge of the pilot training school at [[Imperial City Naval Base]], where he mentored recruits like [[Villian Dance]].<ref name="ds" />

[[File:VadersTIEAdvanced-TCGCore.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Darth Vader (pictured in [[Darth Vader's TIE Advanced/Legends|his TIE Advanced]]), who shot Barvel down]]
At some point prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Barvel, who was a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] by then, was flying in a training exercise using powered-down [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] with several pilots when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] arrived. An elite pilot himself, Vader requested a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] to fly alongside the others and test his skill. After just seconds, he had eliminated all the other pilots save for Barvel. Vader flew behind Barvel, matching him maneuver for maneuver. Though Vader was unable to shoot down Barvel immediately, it was quickly apparent to the watchers that the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] was merely toying with Barvel—a fact made evident when Vader simply swooped down behind Barvel and shot him down, ending the exercise before Barvel could react.<ref name="ds" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Barvel took part in a skirmish against at least one [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]]. Though defeated in the fight, the Imperial pilot managed to escape in his crippled TIE Fighter.<ref name="SWG" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Barvel had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and light skin.<ref name="SWG" />

==Skills and abilities==
Vil Dance and numerous other pilots considered Barvel to be one of the best, if not the best, TIE pilots in the Imperial Navy. He was able to shoot down over sixty enemy ships in the Clone Wars, qualifying him for [[Ace/Legends|ace]] status twelve times over. Dance interpreted Barvel could power-dive the wings off any other craft and hit a target the size of a [[pleeky]] on the way down at top speed, port or starboard cannon, with any weapon. However, when he flew with Darth Vader, Barvel was outmatched and beaten relatively easily.<ref name="ds" />

==Equipment==
When in his TIE Fighter, Barvel wore an [[Imperial Navy crewman]]'s [[Imperial military uniforms/Legends|uniform]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vindoo Barvel was created for the [[2007]] novel [[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']], written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]], in which he was mentioned by Villian Dance, one of the primary protagonists, as an expert pilot.<ref name="ds" /> Barvel, in his TIE Fighter, would reappear in [[canon]] when he was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' in [[W:C:SWG:Game Update 20|Game Update 20]] as one of various, randomly-generated "[[W:C:SWG:Ace Pilot System|elite pilots]]" whom the player, as a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] character, can fight in a [[W:C:SWG:Tier|Tier 7]] [[W:C:SWG:Destroy Duty Missions|Duty Mission]]. A message indicates that the player successfully defeated Barvel once vanquished. The player then receives a [[W:C:SWG:Collection|collection]] icon for the feat.<ref name="SWG" />
